retrieved_item.content: Adversarial omission check: the CLI handoff text (packages/orion-research-harness/src/orion_research_harness/cli.py line 52) mentions GITHUB or other custom capabilities as host-serviced kinds, but no GITHUB capability is requested by any provider in broker.py, serviced by local_tools.py, or exercised by any test under packages/orion-research-harness/tests/. GITHUB is documentation-only surface, not an implemented capability kind. All eight implemented kinds (LLM_COMPLETE, WEB_SEARCH, VERIFY_EVIDENCE, FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, FILE_LIST, SHELL, PYTHON) have at least one test.
